title: Websites with an agent · louis-agent
text: Resting It breathes, and waits for you. Resting Listening Thinking Answering Your doors close at five. Your website doesn't. It answers the question someone asks at 11 at night, and has their details waiting for you in the morning. Ask for yours Watch one work what it does It does more than chat. Four things it does for every visitor. You can watch each one happen. It takes them to the right place. A guest wants a sea view and is bringing a dog. Only the garden room takes dogs, so that is the room it opens. ShowPage It shows the booking as a card. The request comes back as a clear card, not a wall of text. ShowCard It asks before it sends. Nothing leaves the page until the visitor says yes. Then the request reaches you, once. Offer, then SendLead It shows what each answer cost. Turn any answer over to see what it did, how long it took and what it cost. the usage ledger where it runs Your data stays in South Africa. We host it for you in Azure's South African region. A bigger business can run it on its own servers instead. We host it Your site and its agent run in one sealed box that sees only what you hand it. Or on your own servers A bigger business can keep it in-house, with a model of its own. Your data It stays where you put it. This site runs in Azure's South African region, and says plainly what it keeps. What this site keeps the brand Meet Orbi. The violet ball at the foot of this page is Orbi, the agent that answers for this site. Yours gets a name and a look of its own. The idea People don't remember a company. They remember who they talked to. So your agent gets a face and a name. l louis-agent louis-agent louis-agent louis-agent Your brand, your look Your site wears your colours, light or dark, as the three demos do. See the looks see one work Three businesses. Watch their agents work. The businesses are made up. The agents are real. Watch a recorded run, then try one yourself. koringland.example A law practice It knows what it may not answer, and says so. seemeeu.example A guesthouse It opens the room that fits, not just the one asked for. wheatfieldkitchen.example A restaurant It still answers at ten at night. Custom agents An agent made for your business. A bigger job needs an agent of its own. It works in your words, on your own systems, and asks before it sends. seemeeu.example Seemeeu Guesthouse HOME ROOMS STAY The sea-view doubles R1,450 a night The family room R1,850 a night The garden room R1,250 a night. What it reaches Your own systems, such as bookings, stock and your calendar. It reads your data. It never guesses it. Closed and measured It runs in a sealed box that sees only what you hand it. Every answer is priced, and the bill is shown in rand. Who builds it Built by Louis Marais in Malmesbury. He builds your website, hosts it and keeps it running.
